paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Mean absolute values before and after gating. The baseline and post-gating values are similar.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Фигурата илюстрира сравнение на средните абсолютни стойности на скритите състояния преди и след прилагането на вратата (gate) във възел на слой, както и сравнение с базовия модел, като всички стойности са измерени по слоеве. Осата X е обозначена като "Layer" и представлява целочислени стойности от 0 до 22, с равномерно разположени етикети на всяка трета стойност (0, 3, 6, ..., 21). Осата Y е обозначена като "Abs Mean" и показва стойности от 0 до 4, с единици на всяка единица (0, 1, 2, 3, 4), като скалата е линейна. В графиката са представени три линии: синя пунктирана линия, означаваща "hidden state mean before gate", която започва със стойност около 0.2 при слой 0 и се увеличава до около 0.4 при слой 12, след което се стабилизира около 0.3 до слой 18, после рязко се повишава до над 4 при слой 22; оранжева пунктирна линия, означаваща "hidden state mean after gate", която започва със стойност около 0.02 при слой 0 и леко се увеличава до около 0.03 при слой 22; и зелена плътна линия, означаваща "hidden state mean of baseline", която започва със стойност около 0.01 при слой 0 и леко се увеличава до около 0.03 при слой 22.
model_annotations.Chinese: The graph, titled "Hidden State Mean," displays the mean absolute values of hidden states across different layers for three distinct cases: the hidden state mean before the gate, the hidden state mean after the gate, and the hidden state mean of the baseline. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," represents the layer index and spans from 0 to 25 with a linear scale, marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," represents the mean absolute value and ranges from 0 to 4 on a linear scale, with markings at intervals of 1. The blue dashed line, corresponding to the "hidden state mean before gate," starts at a value of approximately 0.1 at layer 0, fluctuates slightly between 0.2 and 0.4 across layers 1 to 20, and then sharply increases to a value of approximately 4.4 at layer 23. The orange dotted line, representing the "hidden state mean after gate," remains consistently low, starting at approximately 0.02 at layer 0 and increasing very gradually to a value of about 0.04 at layer 23. The green solid line, indicating the "hidden state mean of baseline," begins at approximately 0.01 at layer 0 and slowly rises to a value of about 0.08 at layer 23.
model_annotations.English: The plot, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across different layers in a neural network, comparing three conditions: the hidden state mean before the gate, the hidden state mean after the gate, and the hidden state mean of the baseline. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the absolute mean, ranging from 0 to 4. The dashed blue line, labeled "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," shows a relatively stable trend with minor fluctuations, starting at approximately 0.1 and ending near 4.4. The dotted orange line, labeled "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," remains consistently low and flat, hovering just above 0. The solid green line, labeled "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04," also remains nearly flat and close to 0 throughout the layers. The caption indicates that the baseline and post-gating values are similar, which is visually supported by the proximity of the orange and green lines, both staying near 0. In contrast, the values before gating exhibit a significant increase, especially towards the later layers, indicating a strong non-linearity introduced by the gating mechanism.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt den Verlauf des absoluten Mittelwerts der versteckten Zustände über die Schichten eines Modells, vergleicht dabei den Wert vor und nach der Anwendung eines Gating-Mechanismus und stellt diesen im Vergleich zum Baseline-Wert dar. Die x-Achse ist als „Layer“ beschriftet und repräsentiert die Schichtnummer, mit einem linearen Skalierungsbereich von 0 bis 25, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 5 angegeben sind. Die y-Achse ist als „Abs Mean“ beschriftet und misst den absoluten Mittelwert, mit einem linearen Skalierungsbereich von 0 bis 4, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 1 angegeben sind. Dargestellt sind drei Linien: die blaue gestrichelte Linie mit runden Markierungen, die den „hidden state mean before gate“ darstellt, beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 0.2 bei Schicht 0, zeigt einen leichten Anstieg bis zu einem Wert von etwa 0.5 bei Schicht 8, bleibt dann bis Schicht 15 relativ konstant, steigt dann bis zu einem Wert von etwa 2.8 bei Schicht 20 und fällt dann leicht ab, um bei Schicht 25 bei etwa 4.3 zu enden. Die orange punktierte Linie mit runden Markierungen, die den „hidden state mean after gate“ darstellt, beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 0.02 bei Schicht 0, bleibt bis Schicht 20 nahezu konstant bei Werten zwischen 0.02 und 0.04 und endet bei Schicht 25 bei etwa 0.05. Die grüne durchgezogene Linie mit runden Markierungen, die den „hidden state mean of baseline“ darstellt, beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 0.01 bei Schicht 0, steigt leicht bis zu einem Wert von etwa 0.03 bei Schicht 25 und bleibt dort relativ konstant.
